title: NeuroProlog: Multi-Task Fine-Tuning for Neurosymbolic Mathematical Reasoning via the Cocktail Effect
abstract: arXiv:2603.02504v3 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: Large Language Models (LLMs) achieve strong performance on natural language tasks but remain unreliable in mathematical reasoning, frequently generating fluent yet logically inconsistent solutions. We present \textbf{NeuroProlog}, a neurosymbolic framework that ensures verifiable reasoning by compiling math word problems into executable Prolog programs with formal verification guarantees. We propose a multi-task Cocktail training strategy that jointly optimizes three synergistic objectives in a unified symbolic representation space: (i) mathematical formula-to-rule translation (KB), (ii) natural language-to-program synthesis (SOLVE), and (iii) program-answer alignment. This joint supervision enables positive transfer, where symbolic grounding in formula translation directly improves compositional reasoning capabilities. translated_title: NeuroProlog：基于“鸡尾酒效应”的多任务微调实现神经符号数学推理
translated_abstract: 大语言模型（LLMs）在自然语言任务上表现出色，但在数学推理方面仍然不可靠，经常生成看似流畅但逻辑不一致的解决方案。我们提出了**NeuroProlog**，这是一个神经符号框架，通过将数学应用题编译为具有形式化验证保证的可执行Prolog程序，从而确保推理的可验证性。我们提出了一种多任务“鸡尾酒”（Cocktail）训练策略，在统一的符号表示空间中联合优化三个协同目标：(i) 数学公式到规则的翻译（KB），(ii) 自然语言到程序的合成（SOLVE），以及 (iii) 程序-答案对齐。这种联合监督实现了正向迁移效应，其中公式翻译中的符号基础直接提升了组合推理能力。在推理阶段，我们引入了一种具有细粒度错误分类体系的执行引导解码流程，支持迭代（原文在此处截断）……
tldr: 该论文提出NeuroProlog神经符号框架，通过“鸡尾酒”多任务训练策略在统一符号空间中联合优化公式翻译、程序合成和答案对齐三个目标，将数学应用题编译为可形式化验证的Prolog程序，利用正向迁移显著提升大语言模型数学推理的可靠性与可验证性。
en_tdlr: NeuroProlog introduces a neurosymbolic framework with a multi-task "Cocktail" training strategy that jointly optimizes formula-to-rule translation, natural language-to-program synthesis, and program-answer alignment, compiling math word problems into formally verifiable Prolog programs to enhance the reliability of LLM mathematical reasoning through positive transfer.
